newsitem.title: USA: U.S. T-bond extends rally in active late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. T-bond extends rally in active late trading.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries extended early gains in active late trade as investors continued to buy after the release of a batch of market-friendly economic statistics on Thursday, analysts said.
The 6-1/2-percent 30-year benchmark Treasury bond was up 1-16/32 at 98-28/32. Its yield dropped to 6.586 percent, the lowest since December 13 close.
"The market really liked the numbers today and decided to go on buying," said a U.S. investment bank trader.

The market was specially pleased with the release of a strong upward revision in the jobless claims numbers for the week ended December 7 and a surprising weak headline number for the December Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank survey.
